finding: P99 describes linear North, West, South, East progression through temporary per-wing keys or lockpicking. The entry Key to Charasis is separate. The imported player script instead implements a persistent Hand of Glory master-key/keyring bypass; this is not established as a genuine P99 quest prerequisite.
decision: Do not invent or enable a permanent master-key bypass. Retain the source as a conflicting dungeon-key contract. Ranger epic1.5 hooks are independently later-era. Missing keyring and mutable-door support are secondary runtime limitations, not proof the master-key feature belongs in P99.
